title: ContextReportedPayload

contextTokens.description: Input tokens of the latest main request, including cache reads and writes; excludes output and delegated requests.

contextWindow.description: This model's context window, only when reported by the provider.

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

description: context.reported: replaces the run's latest main request context reading.
